name: Mission: Scarlet Stars
source:
*Mission: Scarlet Stars* follows the story of Stephan, a service robot stuck in an eerie death game with even eerier participants. As death, murder and distrust grow rampant within their confines, Stephan and his fellow participants will be forced to piece together just why any of this is happening...

[From [url=https://scarlet-stars.itch.io/missionscarlet-stars]Itch.io[/url]]
